subtitle: Meter chaalu. Aaj samundar wale raste se nikalte hain.
tts_text: मीटर चालू। आज समंदर वाले रास्ते से निकलते हैं।
english_meaning: Meter on. Let's take the seaside road today.
direction: Warm Mumbai driver, speaking easily rather than announcing catchphrases.

subtitle: Laal batti hai. Jaldi karke bhi kya milna hai?
tts_text: लाल बत्ती है। जल्दी करके भी क्या मिलना है?
english_meaning: It's a red light. What's the point of rushing?
direction: Warm Mumbai driver, speaking easily rather than announcing catchphrases.

subtitle: Is hawa ke liye toh roz idhar aana banta hai.
tts_text: इस हवा के लिए तो रोज़ इधर आना बनता है।
english_meaning: This breeze is worth coming here every day.
direction: Warm Mumbai driver, speaking easily rather than announcing catchphrases.

subtitle: Apna adda! Dekhein, aaj kiski kahaani chal rahi hai.
tts_text: अपना अड्डा! देखें, आज किसकी कहानी चल रही है।
english_meaning: Our stand! Let's hear today's stories.
direction: Warm Mumbai driver, speaking easily rather than announcing catchphrases.

subtitle: Sachin! Chaabi le li? Aaj lambi sair ka iraada hai?
tts_text: सचिन! चाबी ले ली? आज लंबी सैर का इरादा है?
english_meaning: Sachin! Got the keys? Planning a long drive today?
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Paintees saal se meter chala raha hoon. Kisse bahut hain.
tts_text: पैंतीस साल से मीटर चला रहा हूँ। किस्से बहुत हैं।
english_meaning: Thirty-five years behind a meter. Plenty of stories.
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: O driver! Sadak dekh, mujhe retirement toh lene de!
tts_text: ओ ड्राइवर! सड़क देख, मुझे रिटायरमेंट तो लेने दे!
english_meaning: Watch the road, driver! Let me reach retirement!
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Kal ka match dekha? Aakhri over mein jaan atak gayi!
tts_text: कल का मैच देखा? आख़िरी ओवर में जान अटक गई!
english_meaning: Saw the match? That last over was tense!
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Hamare adde pe toh sab kursi chhod ke khade the!
tts_text: हमारे अड्डे पे तो सब कुर्सी छोड़ के खड़े थे!
english_meaning: Everyone at our stand was out of their seat!
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Sabzi ka bhaav suna? Tamatar bade akad mein hain!
tts_text: सब्ज़ी का भाव सुना? टमाटर बड़े अकड़ में हैं!
english_meaning: Seen vegetable prices? Tomatoes are getting rather proud!
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Pehle thaila bharta tha. Ab jeb khaali hoti hai.
tts_text: पहले थैला भरता था। अब जेब खाली होती है।
english_meaning: The bag used to fill up. Now the pocket just empties.
direction: Older driver with affectionate dry humour; an easy conversation.

subtitle: Adrak ki chai! Biscuit dubana, par cup mein chhodna mat.
tts_text: अदरक की चाय! बिस्कुट डुबाना, पर कप में छोड़ना मत।
english_meaning: Ginger chai! Dip your biscuit, but don't leave it in the cup.
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Garam ketli hai! Gaadi zara udhar rakhna!
tts_text: गरम केतली है! गाड़ी ज़रा उधर रखना!
english_meaning: This kettle's hot! Keep your vehicle over there!
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Aakhri ball pe sab cheekhe na? Chai bhi uchhal gayi!
tts_text: आख़िरी बॉल पे सब चीखे ना? चाय भी उछल गई!
english_meaning: Everyone yelled on that last ball, right? Even the chai jumped!
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Meri tapri pe toh cup rakhne ki jagah nahi thi!
tts_text: मेरी टपरी पे तो कप रखने की जगह नहीं थी!
english_meaning: My stall was so packed there was nowhere for a cup!
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Bazaar mein aaj phir rate badhe kya?
tts_text: बाज़ार में आज फिर रेट बढ़े क्या?
english_meaning: Did market prices go up again today?
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Sab mehenga. Chai mein pyaar abhi bhi muft hai!
tts_text: सब महँगा। चाय में प्यार अभी भी मुफ़्त है!
english_meaning: Everything's costly. Love in the chai is still free!
direction: Chai-stall owner, warm and busy, with a smile in her voice.

subtitle: Pana kidhar gaya? Abhi toh yahin rakha tha.
tts_text: पाना किधर गया? अभी तो यहीं रखा था।
english_meaning: Where's my spanner? I just put it here.
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Brake daba! Yahaan neeche auzaar pade hain!
tts_text: ब्रेक दबा! यहाँ नीचे औज़ार पड़े हैं!
english_meaning: Hit the brakes! There are tools down here!
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Us match ka aakhri over! Tune saans li thi kya?
tts_text: उस मैच का आख़िरी ओवर! तूने साँस ली थी क्या?
english_meaning: That last over! Were you even breathing?
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Garage ka kaam rok diya tha. Kya finish tha!
tts_text: गैराज का काम रोक दिया था। क्या फ़िनिश था!
english_meaning: We stopped work at the garage. What a finish!
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Baadal dekh. Lagta hai aaj paani barsega?
tts_text: बादल देख। लगता है आज पानी बरसेगा?
english_meaning: Look at those clouds. Think it'll rain?
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Auzaar andar kar leta hoon. Zang phir saaf karna padega.
tts_text: औज़ार अंदर कर लेता हूँ। ज़ंग फिर साफ़ करना पड़ेगा।
english_meaning: I'll bring the tools in. Otherwise I'll be cleaning off rust.
direction: Practical young mechanic, low and conversational, amused by workshop life.

subtitle: Phone ki battery gayi. Ab boss ko kya bahaana doon?
tts_text: फ़ोन की बैटरी गई। अब बॉस को क्या बहाना दूँ?
english_meaning: My phone's dead. What excuse do I give my boss?
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Saamne dekhiye! Bag se zyada meri jaan keemti hai!
tts_text: सामने देखिए! बैग से ज़्यादा मेरी जान कीमती है!
english_meaning: Look ahead! My life's worth more than my bag!
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Subah ki local mein khade hone ki jagah mili?
tts_text: सुबह की लोकल में खड़े होने की जगह मिली?
english_meaning: Was there even standing room on the morning local?
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Bag andar tha, main darwaaze pe. Roz ka yoga!
tts_text: बैग अंदर था, मैं दरवाज़े पे। रोज़ का योगा!
english_meaning: My bag was inside; I was at the door. Daily yoga!
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Tera bhi kiraya badha kya? Malik ka message aaya hai.
tts_text: तेरा भी किराया बढ़ा क्या? मालिक का मैसेज आया है।
english_meaning: Did your rent go up too? My landlord texted.
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Tankhwaah wahi, kiraya naya. Hisaab kaise baithega?
tts_text: तनख़्वाह वही, किराया नया। हिसाब कैसे बैठेगा?
english_meaning: Same salary, new rent. How will that add up?
direction: Young office commuter, alert and slightly hurried, talking to a neighbour.

subtitle: Attendance kam hai, par canteen waala mujhe roz dekhta hai.
tts_text: अटेंडेंस कम है, पर कैंटीन वाला मुझे रोज़ देखता है।
english_meaning: My attendance is low, but the canteen guy sees me daily.
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Hero, picture ki shooting nahi chal rahi! Brake maar!
tts_text: हीरो, पिक्चर की शूटिंग नहीं चल रही! ब्रेक मार!
english_meaning: Hero, this isn't a film shoot! Brake!
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Bhai, kal ka finish dekha? Poora hostel uchhal pada!
tts_text: भाई, कल का फ़िनिश देखा? पूरा हॉस्टल उछल पड़ा!
english_meaning: Saw yesterday's finish? The whole hostel jumped!
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Highlights teen baar dekhe. Phir bhi dhadkan tez hoti hai!
tts_text: हाइलाइट्स तीन बार देखे। फिर भी धड़कन तेज़ होती है!
english_meaning: Watched the highlights three times. Still gets my heart racing!
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Aaj local mein chadh paaye? Bheed zabardast thi.
tts_text: आज लोकल में चढ़ पाए? भीड़ ज़बरदस्त थी।
english_meaning: Managed to board the local? It was packed.
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Chadh toh gaya. Utarne ka plan agle station pe bana.
tts_text: चढ़ तो गया। उतरने का प्लान अगले स्टेशन पे बना।
english_meaning: I got on. Figured out getting off at the next station.
direction: College student, playful and quick, chatting without shouting.

subtitle: Mogryacha gajra ghya! Aaj ke phool bade khushboodaar hain.
tts_text: मोगऱ्याचा गजरा घ्या! आज के फूल बड़े ख़ुशबूदार हैं।
english_meaning: Take a jasmine garland! Today's flowers smell wonderful.
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Tokri bachao! Subah se piroye hain ye phool!
tts_text: टोकरी बचाओ! सुबह से पिरोए हैं ये फूल!
english_meaning: Mind the basket! I've been threading these flowers all morning!
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Bhaji ke daam dekhe? Aaj toh kamaal ho gaya.
tts_text: भाजी के दाम देखे? आज तो कमाल हो गया।
english_meaning: Seen vegetable prices? Today was something else.
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Aadha kilo liya, phir bhi sau ka note gaya.
tts_text: आधा किलो लिया, फिर भी सौ का नोट गया।
english_meaning: Bought half a kilo and still lost a hundred.
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Paaoos yenaar ka? Aasmaan ka rang badal raha hai.
tts_text: पाऊस येणार का? आसमान का रंग बदल रहा है।
english_meaning: Will it rain? The sky's changing colour.
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Phool dhak deti hoon. Bheeg gaye toh kaun lega?
tts_text: फूल ढक देती हूँ। भीग गए तो कौन लेगा?
english_meaning: I'll cover the flowers. Who'd buy them soaked?
direction: Mature flower seller with a gentle Marathi cadence and earthy humour.

subtitle: Zebra crossing khaali rakhiye. Paidal waalon ko bhi nikalne dijiye.
tts_text: ज़ेब्रा क्रॉसिंग खाली रखिए। पैदल वालों को भी निकलने दीजिए।
english_meaning: Keep the crossing clear. Let people walk through.
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Gaadi roko! Logon ke beech aise chalaate hain kya?
tts_text: गाड़ी रोको! लोगों के बीच ऐसे चलाते हैं क्या?
english_meaning: Stop! Is that how you drive around people?
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Local ki bheed ka kya haal tha aaj?
tts_text: लोकल की भीड़ का क्या हाल था आज?
english_meaning: How crowded was the local today?
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Platform bhi bhara tha. Sab ek hi waqt nikalte hain.
tts_text: प्लैटफ़ॉर्म भी भरा था। सब एक ही वक़्त निकलते हैं।
english_meaning: Even the platform was full. Everyone leaves at the same time.
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Aaj baarish lag rahi hai. Chhatri laaye ho?
tts_text: आज बारिश लग रही है। छतरी लाए हो?
english_meaning: Looks like rain. Did you bring an umbrella?
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Raincoat chowki mein hai. Bas pehle wahaan pahunch jaaun.
tts_text: रेनकोट चौकी में है। बस पहले वहाँ पहुँच जाऊँ।
english_meaning: My raincoat's at the post. Hope I get there first.
direction: Male traffic constable, firm and clear, relaxed when chatting off duty.

subtitle: Naam dekh ke dabba uthao. Kal sabzi badal gayi thi!
tts_text: नाम देख के डब्बा उठाओ। कल सब्ज़ी बदल गई थी!
english_meaning: Check the name on the tiffin. Yesterday the lunches got swapped!
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Khaana gir jaayega! Thodi jagah chhod ke chalo!
tts_text: खाना गिर जाएगा! थोड़ी जगह छोड़ के चलो!
english_meaning: You'll spill the food! Leave some room!
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Subah train mein pair rakhne ki jagah thi kya?
tts_text: सुबह ट्रेन में पैर रखने की जगह थी क्या?
english_meaning: Was there room to put a foot on the train?
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Dabbon ko jagah mili. Mujhe kisi tarah mil gayi.
tts_text: डब्बों को जगह मिली। मुझे किसी तरह मिल गई।
english_meaning: The tiffins got space. I somehow squeezed in.
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Aaj sabzi khareedi? Rate sun ke paseena aa gaya.
tts_text: आज सब्ज़ी ख़रीदी? रेट सुन के पसीना आ गया।
english_meaning: Bought vegetables today? Those prices made me sweat.
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Ghar se list aayi thi. Aadhee hi le paaya.
tts_text: घर से लिस्ट आई थी। आधी ही ले पाया।
english_meaning: Got a shopping list from home. Could only buy half.
direction: Dabbawala, brisk but friendly, speaking in short natural phrases.

subtitle: Papita meetha niklega. Shakal pe mat jaao iski!
tts_text: पपीता मीठा निकलेगा। शक्ल पे मत जाओ इसकी!
english_meaning: This papaya will be sweet. Don't judge its looks!
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Mera thela! Nazar road pe rakho, phone pe nahi!
tts_text: मेरा ठेला! नज़र रोड पे रखो, फ़ोन पे नहीं!
english_meaning: My cart! Eyes on the road, not your phone!
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Sabzi mandi mein bhaav badh gaye, suna tune?
tts_text: सब्ज़ी मंडी में भाव बढ़ गए, सुना तूने?
english_meaning: Heard the vegetable wholesale prices went up?
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Khareedne waala bhi roye, bechne waala bhi. Kamaal hai!
tts_text: ख़रीदने वाला भी रोए, बेचने वाला भी। कमाल है!
english_meaning: The buyer cries, the seller cries. Amazing!
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Ye baadal toh barasne waale lag rahe hain, nahi?
tts_text: ये बादल तो बरसने वाले लग रहे हैं, नहीं?
english_meaning: Those clouds look ready to rain, don't they?
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Tirpaal taiyaar hai. Pichhli baar sab bheeg gaya tha.
tts_text: तिरपाल तैयार है। पिछली बार सब भीग गया था।
english_meaning: The tarpaulin's ready. Last time everything got soaked.
direction: Confident fruit seller, clear market projection, easy neighbourhood gossip.

subtitle: Akhbaar le lo! Mobile ki battery se toh nahi chalta.
tts_text: अख़बार ले लो! मोबाइल की बैटरी से तो नहीं चलता।
english_meaning: Get your newspaper! It doesn't run on phone batteries.
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Khabar bechta hoon, khud khabar nahi banna mujhe!
tts_text: ख़बर बेचता हूँ, ख़ुद ख़बर नहीं बनना मुझे!
english_meaning: I sell the news. I don't want to become the news!
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Kal match ke waqt gali ka shor suna tha?
tts_text: कल मैच के वक़्त गली का शोर सुना था?
english_meaning: Heard the lane during yesterday's match?
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Akhbaar ki headline bhi wahi. Kamaal ka match tha.
tts_text: अख़बार की हेडलाइन भी वही। कमाल का मैच था।
english_meaning: It made the paper's headline too. Wonderful match.
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Makaan waalon ne phir kiraya badha diya kya?
tts_text: मकान वालों ने फिर किराया बढ़ा दिया क्या?
english_meaning: Did the landlords raise rent again?
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Purane din yaad aate hain. Tab kamra sasta tha.
tts_text: पुराने दिन याद आते हैं। तब कमरा सस्ता था।
english_meaning: I miss the old days. A room was affordable then.
direction: Older newspaper seller, textured and wry, never a loud announcer.

subtitle: Aaj bina alarm ke soungi. Koi phone mat karna.
tts_text: आज बिना अलार्म के सोऊँगी। कोई फ़ोन मत करना।
english_meaning: I'm sleeping without an alarm today. Nobody call me.
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Hospital se nikli hoon abhi! Waapas bhejne ka iraada hai?
tts_text: हॉस्पिटल से निकली हूँ अभी! वापस भेजने का इरादा है?
english_meaning: I just left the hospital! Are you sending me back?
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Local mein aaj bhi dhakka-mukki thi kya?
tts_text: लोकल में आज भी धक्का-मुक्की थी क्या?
english_meaning: Was everyone jostling on the local again?
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Baithna toh door, bag rakhna mushkil tha.
tts_text: बैठना तो दूर, बैग रखना मुश्किल था।
english_meaning: Forget sitting; even finding room for a bag was hard.
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Is mahine kiraya badha? Mere yahaan bhi baat chal rahi hai.
tts_text: इस महीने किराया बढ़ा? मेरे यहाँ भी बात चल रही है।
english_meaning: Did rent rise this month? They're discussing it at mine too.
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Roommate dhoondhni padegi. Akele ab mushkil ho raha hai.
tts_text: रूममेट ढूँढनी पड़ेगी। अकेले अब मुश्किल हो रहा है।
english_meaning: I'll need a roommate. It's getting hard on my own.
direction: Young nurse after her shift, soft, tired and gently funny.

subtitle: Meeting khatam hui, toh uski meeting ka mail aa gaya.
tts_text: मीटिंग ख़त्म हुई, तो उसकी मीटिंग का मेल आ गया।
english_meaning: The meeting ended, then an email arrived about another meeting.
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Laptop toot jaayega! Insurance mein tera naam likhwaaun kya?
tts_text: लैपटॉप टूट जाएगा! इंश्योरेंस में तेरा नाम लिखवाऊँ क्या?
english_meaning: You'll break my laptop! Should I name you on the claim?
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Kiraye ka naya message aaya kya? Darr lagta hai kholne se.
tts_text: किराए का नया मैसेज आया क्या? डर लगता है खोलने से।
english_meaning: Got the new rent message? I'm afraid to open mine.
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Balkani utni hi chhoti. Kiraya bada hota jaa raha hai.
tts_text: बालकनी उतनी ही छोटी। किराया बड़ा होता जा रहा है।
english_meaning: The balcony stays tiny. The rent keeps growing.
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Aakhri over wala match dekha na? Kya chakkar tha!
tts_text: आख़िरी ओवर वाला मैच देखा ना? क्या चक्कर था!
english_meaning: Saw that match go to the last over? What a ride!
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Office group mein abhi tak usi ki charcha hai.
tts_text: ऑफ़िस ग्रुप में अभी तक उसी की चर्चा है।
english_meaning: The office group is still talking about it.
direction: Office commuter, contained and dryly amused by daily life.

subtitle: Purani imaaraton ke rang photo se zyada sundar lagte hain.
tts_text: पुरानी इमारतों के रंग फ़ोटो से ज़्यादा सुंदर लगते हैं।
english_meaning: Old buildings have lovelier colours in person than in photos.
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Meri drawing! Itni chaudi sadak bhi kam pad rahi hai?
tts_text: मेरी ड्रॉइंग! इतनी चौड़ी सड़क भी कम पड़ रही है?
english_meaning: My drawing! Isn't this road wide enough for you?
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Aasmaan dekho. Baarish hone waali hai kya?
tts_text: आसमान देखो। बारिश होने वाली है क्या?
english_meaning: Look at the sky. Is it about to rain?
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Kaagaz andar rakh loon. Ye rang paani mein beh jaayenge.
tts_text: काग़ज़ अंदर रख लूँ। ये रंग पानी में बह जाएँगे।
english_meaning: I'll put the paper away. These colours will wash off.
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Tumhare yahaan bhi kiraya badh raha hai?
tts_text: तुम्हारे यहाँ भी किराया बढ़ रहा है?
english_meaning: Is the rent going up at your place too?
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Itne mein toh deewar pe painting bhi meri honi chahiye.
tts_text: इतने में तो दीवार पे पेंटिंग भी मेरी होनी चाहिए।
english_meaning: For that price, I should at least get to paint the walls.
direction: Curious young artist, light and expressive, speaking to a friend.

subtitle: Address mein 'bade ped ke paas' likha hai. Kaunsa ped?
tts_text: एड्रेस में बड़े पेड़ के पास लिखा है। कौन सा पेड़?
english_meaning: The address says near the big tree. Which tree?
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Dekh ke! Parcel pe fragile likha hai, mujhpe bhi samajh!
tts_text: देख के! पार्सल पे फ़्रैजाइल लिखा है, मुझपे भी समझ!
english_meaning: Watch it! The parcel says fragile. So am I!
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Aaj local phir thoons ke bhari thi kya?
tts_text: आज लोकल फिर ठूँस के भरी थी क्या?
english_meaning: Was the local crammed full again today?
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Ek station ke liye chadha, teen aage jaake utara.
tts_text: एक स्टेशन के लिए चढ़ा, तीन आगे जाके उतरा।
english_meaning: Got on for one stop, managed to get off three later.
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Tera landlord bhi kiraya badha raha hai kya?
tts_text: तेरा लैंडलॉर्ड भी किराया बढ़ा रहा है क्या?
english_meaning: Is your landlord raising the rent too?
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Kamra chhota, bill bada. Mumbai ka alag hi hisaab hai.
tts_text: कमरा छोटा, बिल बड़ा। मुंबई का अलग ही हिसाब है।
english_meaning: Small room, big bill. Mumbai has its own maths.
direction: Young delivery rider, energetic, informal and lightly sarcastic.

subtitle: Kachra dabbe ke andar daalo. Paas mein nahi, andar!
tts_text: कचरा डब्बे के अंदर डालो। पास में नहीं, अंदर!
english_meaning: Put rubbish inside the bin. Not beside it, inside!
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Jhaadu dikh raha hai? Safai karoon ya tujhe bachaaun?
tts_text: झाड़ू दिख रहा है? सफ़ाई करूँ या तुझे बचाऊँ?
english_meaning: See the broom? Should I clean or dodge your vehicle?
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Hawa badal gayi. Aaj baarish hogi na?
tts_text: हवा बदल गई। आज बारिश होगी ना?
english_meaning: The wind changed. It'll rain today, won't it?
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Naala saaf kar diya. Ab log kachra na daalein bas.
tts_text: नाला साफ़ कर दिया। अब लोग कचरा ना डालें बस।
english_meaning: The drain's clear. I just hope nobody throws rubbish in.
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Sabzi waale ne naya bhaav bataya? Kitna badh gaya!
tts_text: सब्ज़ी वाले ने नया भाव बताया? कितना बढ़ गया!
english_meaning: Heard the new vegetable prices? They've shot up!
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Daam badhte hain, tankhwaah sochti hi reh jaati hai.
tts_text: दाम बढ़ते हैं, तनख़्वाह सोचती ही रह जाती है।
english_meaning: Prices go up; the salary is still thinking about it.
direction: Street worker, steady and matter-of-fact, with understated wit.

subtitle: Amchya veli yahaan cycle chalti thi. Ab sabko jaldi hai.
tts_text: आमच्या वेळी यहाँ साइकिल चलती थी। अब सबको जल्दी है।
english_meaning: In our day, bicycles came through here. Now everyone's rushing.
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Beta, aankhein khol! Mujhe ghar tak toh pahunchne de!
tts_text: बेटा, आँखें खोल! मुझे घर तक तो पहुँचने दे!
english_meaning: Open your eyes, dear! At least let me get home!
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Batao, aaj bhaji kitne ki mili? Bhaav sunke darr lagta hai.
tts_text: बताओ, आज भाजी कितने की मिली? भाव सुनके डर लगता है।
english_meaning: What did vegetables cost today? The prices scare me.
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Pehle das rupaye mein thaila bharta tha, beta.
tts_text: पहले दस रुपये में थैला भरता था, बेटा।
english_meaning: Once, ten rupees filled a bag, dear.
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Pados ke ghar ka kiraya bhi badha kya?
tts_text: पड़ोस के घर का किराया भी बढ़ा क्या?
english_meaning: Did the neighbours' rent go up too?
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Ghar wahi purana, par bhaav har saal naya.
tts_text: घर वही पुराना, पर भाव हर साल नया।
english_meaning: Same old house, a new price every year.
direction: Older grandmother, warm, measured and amused, without a frail caricature.

subtitle: Kabootar bhi pose de raha hai. Insaan hi jaldi mein hain.
tts_text: कबूतर भी पोज़ दे रहा है। इंसान ही जल्दी में हैं।
english_meaning: Even the pigeon is posing. Only people are in a hurry.
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Camera sambhalun ya khud ko? Horn se sab nahi hota!
tts_text: कैमरा संभालूँ या ख़ुद को? हॉर्न से सब नहीं होता!
english_meaning: Save my camera or myself? A horn doesn't solve everything!
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Ye kaale baadal dekhe? Baarish kareeb lag rahi hai.
tts_text: ये काले बादल देखे? बारिश करीब लग रही है।
english_meaning: Seen those dark clouds? Rain looks close.
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Camera dhak liya. Bheegi sadak ki photo achhi aayegi.
tts_text: कैमरा ढक लिया। भीगी सड़क की फ़ोटो अच्छी आएगी।
english_meaning: Camera's covered. The wet road will make a lovely photo.
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Kal ke match mein poori gali jaag rahi thi, na?
tts_text: कल के मैच में पूरी गली जाग रही थी, ना?
english_meaning: The whole lane was awake for yesterday's match, right?
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Us jeet ke baad chehron ki photo leni chahiye thi.
tts_text: उस जीत के बाद चेहरों की फ़ोटो लेनी चाहिए थी।
english_meaning: I should've photographed those faces after the win.
direction: Photographer, polite and curious, clear conversational Hindi.

subtitle: Ghadi bolti hai das hazaar steps. Pair bolte hain bas.
tts_text: घड़ी बोलती है दस हज़ार स्टेप्स। पैर बोलते हैं बस।
english_meaning: My watch says ten thousand steps. My feet say enough.
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Footpath pe bhi race? Mujhe jogging toh karne do!
tts_text: फ़ुटपाथ पे भी रेस? मुझे जॉगिंग तो करने दो!
english_meaning: Racing on the pavement too? Let me jog!
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Match ka woh aakhri over yaad hai? Neend ud gayi thi!
tts_text: मैच का वो आख़िरी ओवर याद है? नींद उड़ गई थी!
english_meaning: Remember that last over? It kept me wide awake!
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Cheekh-cheekh ke gala baith gaya. Mazedaar match tha!
tts_text: चीख चीख के गला बैठ गया। मज़ेदार मैच था!
english_meaning: Lost my voice cheering. What a fun match!
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Aaj baarish padegi kya? Baadal toh poore taiyaar hain.
tts_text: आज बारिश पड़ेगी क्या? बादल तो पूरे तैयार हैं।
english_meaning: Will it rain today? The clouds certainly look ready?
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Bheegte hue daudna achha lagta hai. Phone bachana padega.
tts_text: भीगते हुए दौड़ना अच्छा लगता है। फ़ोन बचाना पड़ेगा।
english_meaning: I like running in the rain. Need to protect my phone.
direction: Upbeat jogger, energetic and a little breathy, talking normally.

subtitle: Udhaar kal se band. Ye board roz lagana padta hai.
tts_text: उधार कल से बंद। ये बोर्ड रोज़ लगाना पड़ता है।
english_meaning: No credit from tomorrow. I put that sign up every day.
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.

subtitle: Peti girti toh saara maal toot jaata! Sambhaal gaadi!
tts_text: पेटी गिरती तो सारा माल टूट जाता! संभाल गाड़ी!
english_meaning: If this crate fell, the stock would break! Control your vehicle!
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.

subtitle: Mandi ke rate dekhe? Sabzi bhi sona ho gayi.
tts_text: मंडी के रेट देखे? सब्ज़ी भी सोना हो गई।
english_meaning: Seen market prices? Vegetables are gold now.
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.

subtitle: Grahak mujhse lade, main kisse ladoon? Daam hi aise hain.
tts_text: ग्राहक मुझसे लड़े, मैं किससे लड़ूँ? दाम ही ऐसे हैं।
english_meaning: Customers argue with me. Who do I argue with? Those prices!
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.

subtitle: Local ki bheed se bach paaye aaj?
tts_text: लोकल की भीड़ से बच पाए आज?
english_meaning: Managed to escape the local's crowd today?
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.

subtitle: Do train chhodi. Teesri mein kisi tarah chadha.
tts_text: दो ट्रेन छोड़ी। तीसरी में किसी तरह चढ़ा।
english_meaning: Let two trains go. Somehow boarded the third.
direction: Shop worker, resonant, practical and friendly, with an ordinary speaking voice.
